thread:
incident-bot: P1 alert for tenant MarlinAnalytics — elevated streaming failures and 504s on dedicated pool marlin-vpc-pool-2. metric: streaming chunk timeouts rose from 0.3% -> 9.2% starting 2026-10-12T09:12:01Z. paging @claire_sre. link: https://redwood.example/incidents/1799994321

claire_sre: ack. immediately looking at worker telemetry. seeing repeated RPC timeouts during append-token sequences and sporadic cuda mem fragmentation warnings on worker-11. not a clean OOM, more like allocator fragmentation after a recent model variant swap. collecting traces.

raj_platform: checked deploy history — pool saw an automatic canary promotion yesterday for model rwd-5-large:20261009 -> promoted to default for a small set of tenants. Marlin was not in the canary group, but a routing autoscale rebalance moved some long-context sessions onto worker-11 which had older cache layouts.

claire_sre: logs snippet:
```
2026-10-12T09:12:03Z worker-11 WARN gpu_alloc: fragmentation_detected: largest_free=48MB, requested=120MB
2026-10-12T09:12:04Z worker-11 ERROR stream_write: failed to push chunk: deadline exceeded
2026-10-12T09:12:05Z request-2042 ERROR infer: rwd-5-large v20261009 -> 504 stream timeout
```

nina_quant: we pushed a memory-layout improvement in rwd-5-large:20261009 to reduce peak working set but it changes allocator behavior. should not cause fragmentation but possible on mixed workloads. will join to validate.

tom_support: prepping customer message. Recommended: "We're investigating intermittent streaming failures for your production traffic; applying a tenant-scoped safe pin to stabilize while we investigate. We'll follow up within 20 minutes." Hold sending until mitigation is active.

claire_sre: mitigation plan (tenant-scoped, non-global): 1) apply a tenant override to a stable low-fragment variant rwd-5-stable:20260901 as a 10% canary 2) monitor streaming-success, chunk latencies, allocator fragmentation metrics for 8 minutes 3) if stable -> ramp to 100% 4) collect heap/allocator traces and routing snapshots. command below.

claire_sre: command (ops jumpbox):
```
# apply 10% tenant-only safe pin for MarlinAnalytics
redwoodctl routing set-override --tenant marlinanalytics --model rwd-5-stable --version 20260901 --percent 10 --reason "tenant fallback - streaming timeouts"
```

deploy-bot: routing change accepted, rollout-id=roll-1799994321-a

raj_platform: canary in place. initial effect: streaming failures for Marlin dropped from 9.2% -> 4.1% within 60s. chunk timeout latency p99 improved. allocator fragmentation signals on worker-11 reduced.

nina_quant: collecting model allocator histograms for both variants. stable variant uses a different pooling strategy that should be more robust for long contexts.

claire_sre: starting live heap + allocator trace capture on worker-11. tagging artifacts.

8m check: canary stable -> streaming failures at 0.6%, chunk p99 restored to baseline. recommending ramp to 100% for tenant.

claire_sre: executing ramp to 100% now per plan.

deploy-bot: executing rollout-id=roll-1799994321-b -> 100% complete.

claire_sre: post-roll metrics: streaming failure rate at 0.08%. no new fragmentation warnings. creating RCA ticket INF-56000 and assigning to eng-runtime + quant-team to root cause allocator behavior change.

tom_support: sent customer update: "We've applied a tenant-scoped safe pin to stabilize your streaming requests; engineers are investigating the root cause and will deliver a post-incident summary. No action needed from you now." Customer replied: "Thanks — flow is healthy now." :thumbsup: 

raj_platform: follow-ups/action items:
- INF-56000: reproduce fragmentation with mixed long/short contexts and allocator config from worker-11
- add per-tenant adaptive pinning: when streaming chunk errors > threshold for X minutes, auto-apply a configured safe-variant override and notify on-call
- consider adding a pre-emptive routing cooldown to avoid migrating long ctx sessions onto workers with older cache layouts during model promotions

nina_quant: will compare binary builds and allocator flags between v20260901 and v20261009; if layout change introduced new fragmentation pattern, prepare a patch or revert candidate.

claire_sre: handing off to raj_platform for next-day RCA work. I'm off-call in 30m. escalation contact: @raj_platform.

deploy-bot: incident status -> mitigated. timeline: start=2026-10-12T09:12:01Z, mitigated=2026-10-12T09:19:10Z.

claire_sre: uploading artifacts to INF-56000: allocator traces, worker snapshots, rollout IDs (roll-1799994321-a, roll-1799994321-b), and representative request traces.

tom_support: drafting customer-facing postmortem and internal blameless RCA summary. tagging INF-56000.

raj_platform: capturing feature request: tenant-level adaptive pins with threshold and cooldown. adding to INF-56000 backlog and scheduling a design sync with product + eng next week.

-- end of thread --
